changes: Reuse one passive production-resolution receipt predicate before and after native
Confined fresh module-mode post-native graph and independent production pin binding

fragments.postimage:
ordinary-windows-consumer1:
    if: github.repository == 'Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/development/preview-hardening' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.platform == 'windows-ordinary-consumer1'
    runs-on: windows-2025
    timeout-minutes: 120
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '2'
      GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
      GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'false'
      GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1: core.longpaths
      GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1: 'true'
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      # Action references are allowed; no mandatory SHA pinning policy.
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
          verify-signature: true
          overwrite-settings: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - uses: gradle/actions/wrapper-validation@v4
        with:
          min-wrapper-count: 1
          allow-snapshots: false
      - name: Exact existing Rust compiler, no bootstrap or dependency refresh
        run: |
          command -v rustup
          rustup toolchain install 1.98.0 --profile minimal --no-self-update --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: 'cmdline-tools;23.0 platforms;android-37.0'
          accept-android-sdk-licenses: true
          log-accepted-android-sdk-licenses: false
      - name: Qualify SDK23 and current generated source index, not old native tests
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -B - <<'PY'
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          manager = Path(os.environ['ANDROID_HOME']) / 'cmdline-tools/23.0/bin/sdkmanager.bat'
          if not manager.is_file():
              raise SystemExit('Official SDK23 setup is incomplete')
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_PATH'], 'a') as output:
              output.write(str(manager.parent) + '\n')
          PY
          python -B scripts/development/validate_resolutions.py --check
      - name: Actual private ordinary module and POM graphs, then only NEW Windows consumer1
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -B scripts/ci/javafx_ordinary_maven_consumer.py --timeout 6600
      - name: Preserve verification receipts and exact NEW XML, never staged packages or full terminal logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: javafx-ordinary-windows-consumer1-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          path: |
            build/ci-verification/javafx-ordinary-windows/*.json
            build/ci-verification/javafx-ordinary-windows/module/*.json
            build/ci-verification/javafx-ordinary-windows/pom/*.json
            build/ci-verification/javafx-ordinary-windows/native/*.json
            build/ci-verification/javafx-ordinary-windows/native/junit/TEST-*.xml
            build/ci-verification/javafx-ordinary-windows/runtime-candidate/*.json

scope: External source-only derivative of the named existing workflow file, not live registration, Git/native execution, dispatch or adoption
